reasons.overall_mobile: Coherent, attractive mission playable to completion with clear assistance; manual combat confidence and continuous feel remain limited by brief samples and paused method.
reasons.controls: Large stable MOVE/FIRE/route areas and working two-contact input, AIM sight view and scene tap assistance. Moving plus firing lost target centering; precise drags not sufficiently assessed.
reasons.gameplay: Recovery-to-coils-to-upload gives understandable progression and armor windows introduce timing. Much of traversal could be assisted with little health pressure in this method; cannot infer broader depth, continuous challenge or enjoyment.
reasons.presentation: Consistent rain-soaked industrial setting, cyan/amber language, typography and weapon/sight presentation. Dark geometry and visually similar concrete spaces can obscure threats.
reasons.usability: Handbook is concise, route/recovery context changes are helpful, planning map clearly paused and visibly closable, fresh start clear. Threat TURN can face obstruction; COVER/NO IMPACT/INERT COVER do not fully explain how to correct position.
reasons.readability: HUD health/ammo/objective and terminal stats readable in portrait; numbered coil world labels, distant enemies, small map legend and spatial cues demand close inspection.
